# From the root of acme/api

# acme/api already imports fabricahq/public-rules as team.
# In .code-rules/config.yaml, add to sources.team:
#   groups:
#     - practices/testing
#   rules:
#     - techs/go/return-errors

code-rules project sync

code-rules project add rule practices/testing/keep-tests-independent \
  --from team@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

code-rules project add rule techs/go/close-bodies \
  --from https://github.com/fabricahq/code-rules-test-library.git@1.0.0

code-rules project build

# Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .code-rules/generated/RULES.md
